groups.label: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.
groups.printed: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Draconian Disciplinarian
choices.text: Any unit that draws visibility to this unit or any unit it is attached to (including the Transport this unit is embarked in), may use this Warlord's Leadership (LD) characteristic for Pinning and Panic tests.

choices.name: Grand Strategist
choices.text: If your army includes a model with this Warlord trait, during deployment you may give 2 units in your army the Outflank special rule.

choices.name: Master of Command
choices.text: The Warlord gains the Officer (1) special rule. If the Warlord already has the Officer special rule, they increase the value of (X) by 1.

groups.label: Any Imperial Guard unit with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase the following Psychic Powers.
groups.printed: Any Imperial Guard unit with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase the following Psychic Powers.

choices.name: Assail
choices.text:
The Psyker is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Assail

choices.name: Gaze of the Emperor
choices.text:
The Psyker is equipped with the following Psychic Weapon:

- Gaze of the Emperor

choices.name: Mind Shackle
choices.text: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. That target unit is immediately Pinned until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Nightshroud
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any unit they are attached to gain the benefit of Heavy Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Psychic Maelstrom
choices.text: When this power is cast, place a single storm marker within 12" of the Psyker. Each time this Psychic Power is cast, remove any existing storm markers from the battlefield and place a new one within 12" of the Caster. When casting this Psychic Power, a Psyker can instead move the existing storm marker on a successful Psychic test instead of placing a new marker. The storm marker is moved 2D6" on a successful Psychic test. Units within 6" of the storm marker at the end of the Shooting Phase and each Movement Phase take 3D6, Strength 3, AP-, Automatic Hits.

choices.name: Telekinetic Dome
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any unit they are attached to gain a 5+ Invulnerable save until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If the Psyker remained stationary in the previous Movement Phase, this becomes a 4+ Invulnerable save instead.

groups.label: Any Imperial Guard unit with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following prayers:
groups.printed: Any Imperial Guard unit with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following prayers:

choices.name: Litany of Focus
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit has the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Hatred
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

groups.label: Any Imperial Guard unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule may purchase the following Rites:
groups.printed: Any Imperial Guard unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule may purchase the following Rites:

choices.name: Rite of Immolation
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6" of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately suffers an Explodes result per the 10.1 - Vehicle Damage Chart, even if it would normally not.

choices.name: Rite of Repair
choices.text:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the following effects:

- Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3" or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
- Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
- Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.

groups.printed: Guardsmen Squads in your army may purchase Krak Grenade for all models in the unit for 10pts.

army_settings.name: Training Doctrines
army_settings.printed: select one of the following Training Doctrines for your army to gain

options.name: Blitzkrieg
options.printed: Vehicle, Bike and Cavalry units in your army gain the Scout special rule. Infantry units gain the Sprint (1) special rule. Infantry units within 6" of a friendly Vehicle type unit gain the Sprint (2) special rule instead.
game_time: Infantry units within 6" of a friendly Vehicle type unit gain the Sprint (2) special rule instead.

options.name: Buzzsaw
options.printed: Units in your army make 1 extra attack with Heavy Stubbers, Linked Heavy Stubbers, Punisher Gatling Cannons, Heavy Bolters and Linked Heavy Bolters they are equipped with.
game_time: Units in your army make 1 extra attack with Heavy Stubbers, Linked Heavy Stubbers, Punisher Gatling Cannons, Heavy Bolters and Linked Heavy Bolters they are equipped with.

options.name: Jury Rig
options.printed: Vehicle units in army gain the Battle Smith (1) special rule however, these units may only perform the Rite of Repair on themselves.
game_time: these units may only perform the Rite of Repair on themselves.

options.name: Wave Tactics
options.printed: At the start of the Movement Phase, you can spend 1 Command Point to rally Conscripts around a squad. Select 1 Conscript Squad within 18" of a unit with the Officer special rule or as if issuing a Combat Order. The target unit regains D3 slain Conscript models. A Conscript Squad unit may not be targeted by this effect more than once per turn.
